_note: EP06 palette: New Mexico high desert at midnight, near-monochrome cold indigo/violet; one warm accent = chile ristra red (+ a single votive candle on the descanso). La Mala Hora: black rebozo/shawl and dress with violet sheen, milky white eyes, thin pale teeth, no blood. Walker: faded denim + tan. Distinct from EP04 (cold teal, fog, water) and EP05 (warm red rock, ochre).
_culture_markers: adobe church with two bell towers and rounded earthen walls
chile ristras hanging from vigas on a portal
descansos: small white roadside crosses with plastic flowers
New Mexico state road sign with the Zia sun symbol (sign only, never as decoration on the creature)
Sangre de Cristo mountains on the horizon, high-desert chamisa brush
old pickup truck; Spanish-style wall clock in an adobe kitchen
